calls.summary:
# Experiment Approval Workflow Review
Date: 2026-10-08 | Duration: 48.34000015258789m

## Summary
The discussion focused on designing an approval workflow in which a request approval button replaces start experiment, with an optional comment modal and a disabled submission state. Reviewers would see a full-bleed callout and review CTA, while requesters would access the review surface and see an empty state while awaiting action. Review comments should be separated from experiment comments, potentially through a tabular UI or dedicated review tab. Reviewers may edit drafts depending on organization settings, although editing could affect approval eligibility and authors must be tracked for audit. Re-request approval behavior remains undecided for the MVP, and status changes after edits may depend on settings. Proposed UI elements include tab-level approval indicators, a review surface with a header, right rail, body, and Claude-provided summary, while raw JSON diffs should generally be avoided. Future work includes a consistent review surface, notification integration, mobile support, a running-experiment review state, and coordination between design and engineering teams.

## Keywords
experiment approvals, review surface, request approval, UI design, comments integration, organizational permissions

## Action Items
**Gabe Melean**  
Add full bleed callout for requesters (07:35)  
Clarify separation between experiment and review comments (14:50)  
Update UI copy for request approval button (17:18)  
Incorporate navigation from experiment to review surface (20:15)  
Integrate approval control and status UI elements (41:40)  
Continue design iteration on draft experiments (46:00)
